feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 14 September 2026 4:15am
items.description:
##Today##

Largely cloudy and mainly dry to start, then areas of low cloud, mist and fog patches affecting the island at times. Rain then arriving in the evening that could become heavy at times before clearing overnight into Tuesday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 19°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

5-10


##Wind Speed##

18


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

S or SW 5-15, soon increasing 15-20, increasing 20-25 in the evening, veering W or SW 15-20 overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor. Very poor in fog patches. Becoming mainly good later. Hill fog becoming isolated later.


##Comments##

Strong winds developing. Risk of heavy rain later.


##Tomorrow##

Mainly dry to start with sunny intervals, then an increased risk of a few showers developing from the afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-3


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

W or SW 15-20, increasing 25 at times, veering W or NW overnight into Wednesday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Comments##

Occasional strong winds.


##Wednesday, 16 September 2026##
